title: DhwaniTTS Major Update Available!
short_msg: Smart Time & Battery Announcers, Quiet Hours, Online Voice Preview, Home voice save fix & clearer pronunciation!
full_msg:
A brand new major update of DhwaniTTS is now live for all users!

What Was Fixed:
- Fixed the Home Tab default voice saving issue so your chosen voice saves and applies smoothly.
- Improved pronunciation and audio clarity across languages by restoring proper voice synthesis parameters.

What's New:
- Online Voice Preview: Listen to a voice sample before downloading any voice pack.
- Smart Time Announcer: Automatic time announcements at chosen intervals with 5 custom alert tones and Silent/Vibrate mode support.
- Smart Battery & Power Announcer: Periodic battery updates, Low Battery (20%) and Full Charge (100%) alerts, plus Charger Connect/Disconnect announcements.
- Quiet Hours: Pause announcements automatically during your sleep hours.
- Real-Time Notifications: Instant alerts with a soft, pleasant chime tone.

Tap the link below to download and install the latest version now!
